size.desktop: ≥900px: .d-wide (≤960px); two lanes, each a two-column grid: canvas slot ~55% wide, sticky at top var(--sp-4), 420px reserved; step cards ~45%, each ≥40vh
size.mobile: <900px: one column; canvas slot sticky at top, opaque, ≤50vh (min(420px,50vh) at 600–899px, min(316px,50vh) under 600px); steps scroll beneath. Height <560px: canvas hidden, per-step snapshot in [data-step-snap]

w-samecode-scrolly.notes: Replaces the w-samecode carousel after the user's human review (run/review/human-review.md). Scrollytelling per CURRICULUM §8 step 6; lane controller copied from Ch 03's w-fleet-scrolly. Checks k-02 (lane A, step A3) and k-03 (lane B, step B2) are page-owned cards in the step column; steps A4, B3 and B4 are gated on them via data-gate.
